$comment: Actor-free Ice Mirror idle. Exactly three prepared hero crystals bob on their existing vertical bubble lanes while one transparent hex screen deploys, receives a localized mirror impact, and fades during the 72-frame loop. Five minor shards and eight snowflake cards remain companions; there is no orbit or falling stream.
name: Ice Shield - Mirror Bubble Idle
description: Exactly three distinct glacier crystals keep their vertical bubble motion as a cold transparent hex screen expands, receives one localized mirror impact, holds, and fades. Five small shard companions and eight snowflakes remain secondary; the actor is omitted from the sprite.
author: vfx-pipeline

sprite.$comment: Render at 512px, then pack_sheets downsamples to the 128px gameplay cell. At 12 fps, the three crystals complete two up/down bubble cycles in the six-second loop; the hex screen deploys, takes one mirror hit at frame 9, fades by frame 42, and stays hidden for the rest of the loop.

anchor.$comment: Centered on the protected actor's origin; the actor is omitted from the sprite.

layers.note: Exactly three prepared major crystals bob vertically from fixed, staggered guard stations. Each completes two up/down cycles per loop and stays horizontally anchored; no orbit path is used. Five minor shards stay as local companions.
Eight prepared branching, lance, and rosette cards drift near the three major crystals as small secondary companions; they do not form a separate orbit or falling stream.
The transparent, cold-blue, equal-sided hex expands from actor center, holds through frame 27, then fades at full size by frame 42. One lower vertex points toward the ground.
One translucent cyan outline follows the same regular six-sided screen; it fades with the body and contains no inner ring or spokes.

One localized mirror hit starts as the hex reaches full size at frame 9. Its fracture and eight varied-size 3D facets clear by frame 28 while all three prepared hero crystals continue their existing vertical bob.
